items.name: Pharma techno
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The pharmacy cross at 130 BPM: pulse, tunnel, arms chase, scanner, heartbeat, glitch, spinning plus.

items.name: Cross tunnel
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Flying down an endless plus-shaped tube, faster on the kick, four palettes.

items.name: Vicsek zoom
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The cross is the first step of the Vicsek fractal: an endless zoom into it.

items.name: Julia cross
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The Julia set of z^4 + c, a fractal shaped like a cross, breathing and morphing.

items.name: Mandala
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Polar plasma: waving petals, rings and crosses flowing out of the center.

items.name: Hypno spiral
items.author: Spectre
items.description: An endless zoom twisting into a spiral and back, round to cross and back.

items.name: Dream
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Breathing, crawling contour lines over drifting colors, like the walls on a trip.

items.name: Moire
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Op-art: interference patterns from five ring sources, boiling, inverted on the kick.

items.name: Hyper
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A tesseract and a 16-cell turning in four dimensions, phosphor trails, RGB glitches.

items.name: Hacker
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Bit streams rushing out along the arms, a glitching terminal in the center.

items.name: Outrun
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Synthwave: a striped sunset in the top arm, mountains, a neon grid racing below.

items.name: Dealer
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The pharmacy sign that sells the fun stuff: PHARMA turns DEALER, the menu, the clock stuck at 04:20.

items.name: No health
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The pharmacy that doesn't want your health: heart rate through the roof, acid smiley, side effects.

items.name: Cross heartbeat
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The green cross beating like a heart, waves flowing out.

items.name: Cross rings
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Rainbow crosses zooming out forever.

items.name: Plasma
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The demoscene classic, a seamless loop.

items.name: Rainbow tunnel
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A striped tunnel, a seamless loop.

items.name: Analog clock
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A round face with hands and a smooth second hand, the time and date beside it.

items.name: Binary clock
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Each digit of HH MM SS as a column of four lights: add up the lit ones.

items.name: Digital clock
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Big hours and minutes, the date, the seconds as a bar; the color follows the time of day.

items.name: Word clock
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The time in words, to the nearest five minutes (English or French).

items.name: Countdown
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Days, then hours, minutes and seconds to a date you set in the script; it celebrates at zero.

items.name: How far along
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The day, the week, the month and the year, as progress bars.

items.name: Comets
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Bouncing dots with fading trails; on the cross they bounce off the arms and corners.

items.name: Fire
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Flames rising from the bottom.

items.name: Space invaders
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Marching invaders and a cannon shooting back.

items.name: Kaleidoscope
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Ribbons mirrored eight ways, fading out.

items.name: Lava
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Two layers of smooth noise turned into hot colors.

items.name: Lissajous
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A point tracing curves that slowly change shape, with a fading trail.

items.name: Metaballs
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Blobs of light merging and splitting like a lava lamp.

items.name: RGB moire
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Three sets of rings, red, green and blue, wandering and interfering.

items.name: Zone plate
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Rings closer and closer to the edges: ghost circles appear where the LEDs can't follow.

items.name: Qix
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Lines gliding and swirling with a trail, after the arcade classic.

items.name: Digital rain
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Green streams falling down each column.

items.name: Rotozoom
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A checkerboard turning and zooming, the demoscene classic.

items.name: Starfield
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Flying through space, stars streaming out from the center.

items.name: Tunnel
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Flying down an endless striped tube.

items.name: Matrix rain
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Green drops falling with bright heads and fading tails.

items.name: Rainbow
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A rainbow scrolling across the panel: the smallest script.

items.name: Shapes
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A radar sweep, a spinning triangle, bouncing circles, a breathing frame.

items.name: Spirograph
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A spirograph drawn a few lines at a time, a new one every ten seconds.

items.name: Bouncing balls
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Gravity, bounces off the walls and off each other; on the cross they rest on the arms.

items.name: Boids
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A flock of birds keeping together; the color shows where each one heads.

items.name: Langton's ants
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Three ants flipping cells: chaos, then highways.

items.name: Game of Life
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Conway's cells, born bright and calming down; restarts when it gets stuck.

items.name: Double pendulum
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Two arms, gravity, chaos, and a fading rainbow trail.

items.name: Falling sand
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Colored grains pouring and piling up; on the cross they fill the arms.

items.name: Spectrum bars
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The sound's spectrum as bars, a flash on the beat.

items.name: Equalizer
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Hi-fi bars from green to red with slowly falling peaks.

items.name: Sound fireworks
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Each beat bursts a rocket of sparks.

items.name: Sound history
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The sound scrolling by like a track's waveform.

items.name: Bass plasma
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Plasma dancing to the bass: faster and brighter when it hits.

items.name: Beat rings
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Each beat sends a ring of color out from the center.

items.name: Sound sun
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Rays all around, one per frequency band, slowly turning.

items.name: Beat word
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A word that jumps on every beat.

items.name: Spectrogram
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Time scrolls up, bass on the left, loud is hot.

items.name: Oscilloscope
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The microphone's waveform.

items.name: Text scroll
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A message scrolling across in rainbow letters: change the text in the script.

items.name: Hello World
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Hello World in rainbow colors: a first script to start from.

items.name: Hello console
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Prints to the app's console (Code editor), nothing on the matrix: printBLE for debugging.

items.author: Spectre
items.description: The 42 logo over a rainbow that keeps turning.

items.name: Ditto
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A line of Dittos marching over a rainbow.

items.name: Windows 95
items.author: Spectre
items.description: The Windows 95 3D screensaver: cubes, stars and shapes tumbling through the dark.

items.name: Pokemon parade
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Pokemon sprites walking by one after the other.

items.name: Banana rain
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Bananas tumbling down, the Banane's own.

items.name: Pac-Man
items.author: Spectre
items.description: A Pac-Man maze shaped like the cross: Pac-Man, the ghosts, flashing rainbow walls.

items.name: Pills
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Pills falling from the top and piling up until they fill the cross.

items.name: Pokeballs
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Pokeballs falling and piling up until they fill the cross.

items.name: Water
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Water pouring in, filling the bottom arm, then the sides, at 100 frames a second.

items.name: Fluid rainbow
items.author: Spectre
items.description: Rainbow fluid pouring in and filling the cross in colored layers.
